about_short_description.short_description: Browser-based AI agents for healthcare operations

product.name: Asteroid Healthcare Automation Platform
product.description: A HIPAA-ready platform that uses browser, desktop, Citrix, and API-based agents to automate healthcare workflows across EHRs, payer portals, registries, and other systems without public APIs.

product.name: Healthcare Workflow Automation
product.description: Prebuilt and configurable agents for repetitive healthcare operations, including credentialing, enrollment, prior authorization, eligibility, claims, scheduling, referrals, Medicare, and EHR extraction or write-back.

product.name: Astro Builder
product.description: An AI agent builder that converts a process description or standard operating procedure into a configurable browser agent, allowing non-engineers to create and run workflow automations.

product.name: Managed Agent Delivery
product.description: A professional service in which Asteroid maps a customer’s workflow, customizes existing integrations or builds new agents, and deploys them into the customer’s production workspace.

product.name: Insurance Portal Automation
product.description: Agents that automate multi-carrier insurance quoting, renewal data entry, and claims-status workflows across carrier portals, reducing repetitive manual entry and information retrieval.
